stopping_definition.positive_flag: max(abs(previous normalized state correction)) <= 1e-10; flag is the current iteration number
stopping_definition.minus_one: iteration cap reached while the state-step test remains unsatisfied
stopping_definition.minus_two: initial failure status, retained on numerical or input error
stopping_definition.order: evaluate current residual and save current history; check previous correction; check cap; solve and apply full step

objectives.generation: Phi_e(x)=0.5*||F_e(x)||^2; 3 basic geometric rows, one e^2-target_e^2 row, and one positive-LOS row per observation; all rows use their normalized algebraic scale
objectives.update: A(x)*delta=-F_e(x) by column-pivoted QR; A is a low-order approximation to the full residual Jacobian; the original update uses the whole delta
